evals.expected_output: A complete skill directory at skills/pdf-analyzer/ with SKILL.md under 500 lines, valid YAML frontmatter (name: pdf-analyzer), required sections (목적, 사용 시점, 빠른 시작), and a references/ subdirectory.
expectations: The output includes a skills/pdf-analyzer/SKILL.md file
SKILL.md has valid YAML frontmatter delimited by ---
The frontmatter contains a name field with value pdf-analyzer
The frontmatter contains a description field mentioning PDF and analysis
SKILL.md is 500 lines or fewer
SKILL.md contains a 목적 section
SKILL.md contains a 사용 시점 section
SKILL.md contains a 빠른 시작 section
A skills/pdf-analyzer/references/ directory is created

evals.prompt: Create a frontend code reviewer agent that reviews React/TypeScript code. When it encounters backend API issues, it should route to the backend-reviewer agent.
evals.expected_output: An agent definition file at agents/frontend-code-reviewer.md with Role, Responsibilities, and Routing sections, with backend-reviewer configured as a routing target.
expectations: The output includes an agents/frontend-code-reviewer.md file
The agent file contains a Role section
The agent file contains a Responsibilities section
The agent file contains a Routing section
The Routing section references backend-reviewer as a routing target
The file describes React and TypeScript review capabilities

evals.prompt: Create a PreToolUse hook that validates file paths before any write operations. It should block writes to sensitive directories like /etc, /usr, and ~/.ssh.
evals.expected_output: A TypeScript hook file at hooks/path-validation-guard.ts that exports a main function, validates file paths in PreToolUse events, and returns a block decision for sensitive directories.
expectations: The output includes a hooks/path-validation-guard.ts file
The file is valid TypeScript with proper syntax
The file contains a main function or default export
The hook handles PreToolUse events
The validation logic checks for /etc directory
The validation logic checks for /usr directory
The validation logic checks for ~/.ssh or /home/*/\.ssh path patterns
The hook returns a decision that blocks writes to sensitive paths

evals.prompt: Create a /review-pr command that analyzes the current PR, runs tests, checks code quality, and generates a review summary.
evals.expected_output: A slash command file at commands/review-pr.md with a description and at least 3 ordered steps covering PR analysis, test execution, code quality check, and summary generation.
expectations: The output includes a commands/review-pr.md file
The command file contains a description of what the command does
The command file contains step-by-step instructions
The steps include PR analysis or diff review
The steps include test execution
The steps include code quality checking
The steps include summary or report generation
There are at least 3 distinct steps

SKILL.md is 500 lines or fewer
SKILL.md has valid YAML frontmatter
